entities.summary: Anders Erik Borg is a Swedish politician who served as Minister for Finance in the Swedish government from 2006 to 2014. He is a member of the Swedish Moderate Party. Anders Borg was a performers & entertainers from Skarpnäcks församling (b. 1968-01-11, Skarpnäcks församling). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
